run_dump_chrome_trace: run a function with torch profiler and export a chrome trace to a file
benchmark_function_timing: benchmark a function by running it multiple times and measuring total runtime without the profiler
profile_cuda_activities: profile CUDA activities using torch profiler and export results as a chrome trace
warmup_and_measure: warmup a function with 5 runs then measure timing over a configurable number of runs
synchronize_gpu: synchronize GPU operations before timing to ensure accurate benchmark measurements
